name: exchange-webapp

dependencies.name: exchange-api
dependencies.description: Calls the exchange rate API to list supported currencies and fetch the current USD rate for the selected one.

dependencies.name: thunder-app
dependencies.description: Signs the user in via OIDC + PKCE and provides the bearer token attached to calls to exchange-api.

description: React single-page app where a signed-in user searches/selects a currency and views its current exchange rate to USD along with a last-updated timestamp. Handles sign-in via Thunder and all UI state; holds no exchange-rate data itself and never talks to the external rate provider directly — it always goes through exchange-api.
